hypothesis: The sequential recurrence, original triangular system, factored pair kernel and diagonally scaled triangular system are exactly equivalent with before-token resets and the unchanged 1e-18 norm floor; the scaled system has bounded coefficients and a useful state-stability contract without implying small parameter gradients.
primary_comparator: An independently expressed sequential Fraction recurrence following the frozen core equations; no model or tensor library execution.
primary_metric: Exact rational output/state/directional-derivative discrepancies, contract violations, and exact infinity-norm condition numbers in specified control families.
minimum_useful_effect: Zero exact discrepancies on the declared domain; retain both favorable and unfavorable conditioning examples. No speed, model quality or fully FP32 advance gate is evaluated.
success_rule: Supply an explicit algebraic derivation, independent rational implementations, hand-computed edge controls, exact derivative checks away from the floor kink, reset/chunk checks and a reproducible bounded domain. Report numerical qualification as unperformed.
futility_rule: Stop on a genuine counterexample or after 600 seconds of single-process verification; preserve the exact failing input or incomplete domain. One documented implementation correction/pivot is allowed without changing the equations or floor.

authorization.user_approval_reference: 2026-10-23 donor request and continuation: useful contributions and multiple focused PRs within the original 480-minute session.
authorization.approved_resources: Existing CPU and Python standard library for exact algebra and software tests only. No PyTorch/model import, training/evaluation, checkpoint deserialization, corpus download, dependency installation, cloud or spending.
authorization.max_walltime: Original session through about 14:04 UTC; no new research after 12:04 UTC; final quarter reserved for verification/handoff.
authorization.local_cpu_budget: One process, at most 600 seconds for the finite exact verification, plus small unit tests.

design.equations: S_t=D_t S_(t-1)+u_t k_t v_t^T; u_t=w_t n_t/m_t-beta_t/m_t <k_t,D_t S_(t-1) v_t>; n_t=||v_t||^2, m_t=max(n_t,1e-18). Existing before-token resets retained.
design.scaled_representation: r_t=sqrt(m_t), z_t=v_t/r_t, alpha_t=r_t*u_t. The strict-lower coefficient becomes beta_t <k_t,P_(t,s) k_s><z_t,z_s>, with rhs w_t*n_t/r_t-beta_t<k_t,O_t S_0 z_t>. This is diagonal similarity, not a new architecture.
design.fully_charged_best_case: Same quadratic pair kernels and solve; extra O(T*V) scaling plus T reciprocal-square-roots. No theoretical gain when all value norms are exactly one. Bounded coefficients do not guarantee a better condition number for every input or a passing FP32 gradient gate.
design.matching_track: E01 exact algebra and qualification oracle only
design.seed_selection_method: Four 32-bit words of donor seed, used only for deterministic rational fixture generation.
design.resets: All bit patterns through length 4. At length 8 use masks 0,255,1,128,85,170,24,16.
design.chunks: All compositions through length 4; length 8 uses [8], [1,7], [4,4], [3,2,3], and eight unit chunks.
design.fixture_domains: Rational unit vectors via stereographic parameterization, with zero/small value scales; decay in {1/8,1/2,3/4,1}; beta in {0,1/2,1}; write in {0,1/3,1}. Values/keys have norm at most one. Include zero and exact floor-boundary forward cases.
design.gradient_domain: T=2,K=2,V=2; all four reset patterns, four seeds, unit/strictly-below-floor regimes, zero/nonzero initial states. Check every independent input directional partial (24 per case), excluding the norm-floor kink. Square roots have rational values in these fixtures; derivatives are exact rational dual numbers.
design.conditioning_controls: Collinear two-step values [1,epsilon], [epsilon,1], and [1,1], epsilon in {1/10,1/1000000,1/10000000000}. Preserve reverse-scaling cases where original conditioning is better. Check any claimed general bound separately from finite examples.

data.dataset_versions: No dataset; deterministic rational fixtures only

execution.runtime_versions: Python standard library only; record interpreter in terminal evidence.
execution.fidelity_tolerances: Exact Fraction/Dual equality; no numerical tolerance. Common output factor 1/sqrt(K) is omitted from both sides and restored only in a later explicitly approved floating-point canary.
execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: Clean dedicated worktree. Background research agent owns only its primary-source note; parent owns this package. Frozen evidence never edited.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Exact core equivalence and scoped mathematical contracts, not a model score

evidence.source_manifest: INPUTS.json pins parent source, protocol/addenda and failure receipts
evidence.preservation_policy: Keep all controls, null/unfavorable conditioning results and any implementation failure separately. Never promote finite checks to a proof of all inputs.

decision.next_experiment: A concrete tensor-only numerical canary may be proposed after exact checks; it requires separate exact approval and local dependency/storage permission.
